framework.title: HIPAA Security Rule (45 CFR Part 164, Subpart C)

controls.title: Workforce authorization and access management
controls.statement: Access to ePHI is authorized and supervised; the organization grants, documents, reviews, and terminates each workforce member's access on the principle of minimum necessary use.

evidence.title: Tenant isolation enforced by FORCE row-level security
evidence.summary: all 5 tenant tables enforce FORCE row-level security

controls.title: Audit controls over ePHI systems
controls.statement: Hardware, software, or procedural mechanisms record and examine activity in systems that contain or use ePHI, so that access and changes are attributable and reviewable.

crosswalk.note: Satisfied by the immutable audit log.

evidence.title: Append-only audit chain integrity (WORM-anchored)
evidence.summary: audit chain verified against its anchor (1 entries)

controls.title: Policies, procedures, and documentation retention
controls.statement: Security policies and procedures are documented, and required actions, activities, and assessments are recorded and retained for the regulatory period, available to those responsible for implementing them.

evidence.title: WORM retention meets the legal floor
evidence.summary: WORM retention until 2033-06-27T12:00:00.000Z meets the floor (2032-06-27T12:00:00.000Z)

summary.posture: 3 of 3 controls evidence-ready; no gaps recorded.
